Built blind from data/cache/xpts.json + player_pool.json + GW4 fixture-room/market-desk/intel reports. No sight of the user's squad.

captain_rationale: APEX locked captaincy rule (season cum_pts leader, nailed premium, not GK) plus the intel EO shield. Haaland is 71% owned with ~40% captain share even in a derby week at FDR 4. The model's 3.75 is fixture-suppressed, not ceiling-suppressed. Fading a 111% EO armband is negative EV: it pays on the ~40% of weeks he blanks and costs ~22 pts against the largest bloc on the ~15% he hauls 15+.
vice_rationale: Highest-xpts starter after the differentials (5.18), home to the league's bottom xG side, and 2nd in consensus GW4 captain metrics. Deliberately NOT a doubtful player — the vice is insurance and must itself be nailed.
transfers_note: 0 transfers, 0 hits. This is a clean GW4 build to exactly 100.0m with 0.0 in the bank — no hit is worth taking when the top 3 xpts assets on the board (Bogle, De Cuyper, Trafford) are already in the squad. Watchlist for GW5: Gakpo (7.2m, xpts 6.00, currently 75% fit — buy once the thigh clears) and Gibbs-White (home v IPS/COV in GW5).
chip_rationale: GW4 is a single gameweek with no DGW/BGW alerts from fixture-room. Per APEX chip timing, TC requires a confirmed DGW for the best captain and FH requires a BGW with 4+ blanked starters — neither condition is met. Hold all chips; using at the wrong time costs more than saving.

xpts_breakdown.method: Sim Lab priors — per-player GW4 xpts from data/cache/xpts.json (form, xgi_per90, fixture FDR), captain doubled, bench excluded.

key_differential: Bogle (LEE, DEF, £4.5m, ~1-4% EO) — highest projected xpts of ANY player in the GW4 model at 7.27, FDR 2, and a likely overnight price riser. Secondary punt: Rogers (CHE, £7.6m, ~7% EO) for low-owned exposure to CHE v HUL.
risks: Haaland captain at FDR 4 away at Old Trafford — the model rates him only 3.75; this is an EO shield pick, not an xpts-maximising one. Palmer (C) would have projected ~3.6 more raw xpts.
Bogle and Rogers are both sub-8% EO — if CHE v HUL goes flat and Leeds concede, the differential half of the build underperforms the field by ~8 pts.
Trafford over Raya sacrifices 31% GK template protection to fund Isak. Justified on xpts (+1.03) but it is a live EO fade.
Only 1 Arsenal asset (Calafiori) — Gabriel (27%) and Saka are faded. Tolerable at FDR 3.
sparring_verdict: A top-10k-shaped 3-4-3: fully shielded on the two highest-EO assets in the game (Haaland 111% EO captain, João Pedro 72% starting), triple-loaded on the week's best fixture via the 3-Chelsea cap, and funded by two genuine sub-8% punts with the highest raw projections on the board. 58.2 xPts is the number to beat.
